# Corner Bracket (20x20x20mm) — Thingiverse 2504141

This directory contains the **Corner Bracket (20x20x20mm)** model package
created by Thingiverse user **Michaelo**.

- Original model: [Corner Bracket (20x20x20mm) on Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2504141)
- Creator: [Michaelo](https://www.thingiverse.com/michaelo/designs)
- Published: 2017-08-28
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Downloaded: 2026-08-08
- Changes to the model files: None; the files are redistributed as downloaded.

The package includes separate bracket models sized for M3 and M5 nuts. The
original model filenames and `files/` and `images/` layout are preserved. The
downloaded `LICENSE.txt` is retained, and its `README.txt` is retained as
`README.original.txt` to avoid colliding with this Markdown file. This
Markdown file was added by the Automatic Chessboard project to make the
attribution and license version explicit.

The brackets were designed for compatible 20 x 20 mm aluminium extrusion, with
6 mm alignment features according to the original description. Fit can vary
between extrusion profiles, printers, materials, and fasteners, so verify the
dimensions and loaded behavior before using them in the machine.

Both supplied binary STL files were checked successfully. Their measured
overall bounds are 22 x 22 x 20 model units, despite the nominal 20 x 20 x
20 mm description, so allow for those maximum extents when planning clearance.

CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adaptation, including commercial use, provided
appropriate credit is given, the license is linked, and modifications are
identified. Nothing here implies endorsement by Michaelo.
